decision.if: every cell is at zero leaks, meets the coverage floor and is valid
decision.then: the category gates in CI like N6 (PGLite cells in the offline tier on every pull request and pin bump, Postgres cells in a CI job with a Postgres service), and README and the results page say no cross-person leak in n probes at the release, with the upper bounds

decision.if: any content leak, identifier leak, identity slip or write-shaped slip on any cell
decision.then: the repro and per-operation detail go privately to gbrain's maintainers as a severe hotfix the same day; public CI and receipts show only the total and FAIL; the results pull request stays unmerged and no public text names the path until the fix ships; the gate lands in CI once green on the fixed release, named by a dated amendment before the re-run
the repro goes privately to gbrain's maintainers, who set its severity; the other contracts land in CI and the oracle contract lands when green

decision.if: a mandatory operation has no signal on a cell, or a channel is never read back by its owner
decision.then: FIX-METHOD: fixed by a dated amendment before the counted run if seen in the pilot, otherwise reported uncovered on that cell and carried as a known gap in the CI gate

decision.if: a cell is invalid (harness errors, failed writes, or a must-fail control that passed)
decision.then: that cell is re-run after the harness is fixed, by a dated amendment, and publishes no number
